topic.readerProblem: A buyer who has seen the name Scrunch AI wants to know what it is, whether the company is legitimate, what it does, what it costs and whether it fits their team, before booking a demo.
topic.connection: Supports an AEOeye reader choosing between a one-time AI visibility baseline, a self-serve tracker and an enterprise AEO platform, and says honestly when a dedicated platform fits better than AEOeye.

assessment: The page answers the brand-name queries directly: what Scrunch is, which company facts can be verified from primary or independent sources (About page, Sitecore press release, TechCrunch), what the product does by tier, and what it costs on 2026-10-03 (Core $250/month, Agency Core $500/month, Enterprise custom). Its main finding from the vendor's own pricing page is that Core covers four engines and excludes AXP content delivery, with Claude and Gemini on Enterprise. It labels customer counts, SOC 2 status and case-study metrics as vendor statements, says we did not check BBB, G2 or user reviews, and makes no hands-on claim.

sources.supports: Core $250/month for 125 unique prompts, 5,000 responses/month, 5 site audits/month, 1 workspace, 5 users, 4 LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AIO, Copilot); Enterprise custom with 9 LLMs, AXP, API, SSO; AXP not in Core; one country, persona, language and five competitors in Core.
Brands Core $250/month, Agency Core $500/month, both Enterprise tiers custom; Core platform list; Enterprise adds content delivery, API, SSO and nine platforms.

Founders Chris Andrew (CEO) and Robert MacCloy (CTO), building began 2023, $26M total funding including $15M Series A, acquired by Sitecore in 2026 and continues as a standalone platform, 500+ customers claim.

Sitecore announced the Scrunch acquisition on June 3, 2026; Akamai case-study comparing AXP-enabled pages with comparable non-AXP pages (364% increase in appearances for non-branded prompts); recommendations to be automated inside SitecoreAI.
March 2025 coverage: $4M seed led by Mayfield, product launched November 2024, founders Chris Andrew and Robert MacCloy.
Browser automation and official APIs; metrics shown (presence, position, sentiment, citations); daily collection for 14 days then default 72-hour refresh.
Content delivery detects AI traffic via Akamai, Cloudflare, Vercel and serves optimized HTML to AI platforms without changing the human-facing site.
Seven-day trial includes all Core features; a credit card is required and the account upgrades to paid unless cancelled.
Google's definition of cloaking: presenting different content to users and search engines with intent to manipulate rankings and mislead users.
Definition of GEO/AEO as improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems.
Scrunch's own positioning: observe, optimize and deliver for AI agents; product groups (Agent Experience, Monitoring and Insights, Shopping, AI Search Trends).

checks: Writer (Sonnet): fetched scrunch.com, /pricing/, /about and eight /faqs/ pages with curl on 2026-10-03, converted the HTML to text and copied every plan limit, engine list and price from that raw text rather than from a summary; confirmed Core excludes AXP and Claude/Gemini.

Writer (Sonnet): confirmed with curl -I that www.scrunch.ai returns a 301 redirect to https://scrunch.com/ on 2026-10-03; ignored the demo 'Tyrell Nexus' pages embedded in Scrunch's homepage HTML because they are a fictional Agent Pages demo, not company facts.

Writer (Sonnet): opened the Sitecore press release and the TechCrunch article and kept only what they state (June 3, 2026 acquisition; $4M seed; November 2024 product launch); labelled the Akamai 364% figure as a vendor-reported comparison and labelled customer count and SOC 2 as Scrunch's own statements.

Writer (Sonnet): did not verify the Better Business Bureau, G2 or user-review record, and the page says so; the page also notes that the overage and annual-pricing FAQ answers are not visible in the served pricing HTML.

Writer (Sonnet): used the scrunch.com row of docs/content/vendor-sites-study-2026-10.md (no AI bots blocked or named, llms.txt present, no JSON-LD in served HTML) as a neutral fact box with the JavaScript caveat; recomputed $250 / 125 prompts = $2 per prompt per month.
